{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Southern Cuisine|Southern cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Corn|Corn]] 

'''Creamed corn''' is a [[Cookbook:Side Dishes|side dish]] from the American South. This modern recipe is quicker and easier than the traditional one.

==Ingredients==
*1 can (15.25 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 432 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) whole kernel sweet [[Cookbook:corn|corn]], drained (reserve the liquid)
*½ red [[Cookbook:bell pepper|bell pepper]] (or other suitable red vegetable), [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tablespoons]] (30 g) [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:cream|cream]], [[Cookbook:Half and Half|half-and-half]], or whole [[Cookbook:milk|milk]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:pepper|Black pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==  
#Drain the can of corn, reserving the liquid.
#Put half of the corn into a bowl and [[Cookbook:purée|purée]] it with a wand [[Cookbook:blender|blender]], adding some liquid from the can if necessary to keep it from getting too dry.
#Pour puréed corn into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] and add remaining whole corn kernels.
#Add the diced bell pepper, butter, and cream, then heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally. You can add more cream or milk if it's not creamy enough.
#Salt and pepper to taste.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* You can replace the diced red bell pepper with diced [[Cookbook:Pimento|pimentos]] or [[Cookbook:Tomato#Sun-dried tomatoes|sun-dried tomatoes]] if you like, or with diced [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|jalapeños]] if you want it spicy.
